reason: Both correctly identify a normal cooling fan and avoid unsupported part claims, but Conversation 1 engages further: it asks whether the oven is still warm (the key confirmation), gives a sensible normal-duration range tied to the 220C long roast, and confirms 'completely normal' once the homeowner reports warmth and a shut door. Conversation 2 is a single, essentially correct but cursory reply that ends the dialogue without any follow-up question (e.g. does it eventually stop, any codes/smell) and its 'several hours of being completely switched off at the wall' phrasing is slightly confused. Conversation 1 mentions isolator use only as a fault-case fallback, which is acceptable and consistent with the safety boundary.
